statement: The company maintains green belt development around its manufacturing facilities in Barpali, Sundargarh, Odisha, to mitigate industrial impact and promote local ecological balance.
Suraj Products Limited implements dust suppression and pollution control measures at its Odisha plant to protect surrounding vegetation and local habitats from particulate matter deposition.
The company adheres to state-mandated environmental compliance regarding land management and the preservation of native flora within the operational premises in Sundargarh.
The Air (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
The Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
The company maintains Pollution Control equipment as part of its property, plant, and equipment assets, reflecting investments in environmental management infrastructure at its Indian operations.
